ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram shows three plants at different stages of growth. Which stage is the youngest?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are three plants arranged from left to right on a pile of soil; the plant on the left is the smallest and shortest, with fewer leaves; the middle plant is taller; the plant on the right is the tallest and most developed. The text labels “Stage 1/2/3” are not clearly shown in the figure. Reasoning: Among plant growth stages, the youngest is usually the smallest and least developed stage. The question asks which stage is the youngest; according to common stage numbering, Stage 1 represents the earliest growth stage, so the youngest is Stage 1.
